letter.body: I'm writing this letter to inform you that I've been smoking Winston cigarettes for a very long time. Just recently I purchased a carton of Winston Select (full flavor) cigarettes and every pack in the carton was stale. Up until now I must say I was one of your better customers. I'm what you might call a Winston woman. I hope that this doesn't happen anymore. I feel that I've wasted money that I work very hard for. I would appreciate it if the company would try to take care of this problem.
letter.additional_note: I would appreciate a reply upon review of this letter.
